owner_boundary: Trigger7 supplies only a research-derived candidate falsifier. Trigger4 owns any product test implementation, execution, receipts, state transition and acceptance. Do not mutate or redispatch active HF09/HF10, ASR004 or WP715 runtime subjects from this packet.

donor_boundary.reason: The donor exposes useful disfluency, multi-step tool and rollback axes, but its released benchmark is not German and its corpus license should not be silently imported into distributable F2 fixtures.

hypothesis.statement: A small original German deterministic test matrix combining disfluency, correction and tool-result causal fencing will reveal voice/tool integration failures not exposed by isolated ASR/TTS or ordinary tool tests.
hypothesis.counterhypothesis: Existing HF02-HF10 and WP715 tests already exercise the relevant causal boundaries; an additional matrix produces no new failure class and should not be scaled.
hypothesis.decision_rule: Implement only the minimum orthogonal pilot. Scale only if it produces a genuinely new executable failure class or closes a named evidence gap.

minimum_original_pilot.fixture_policy: Author new German fixtures inside F2; do not translate or copy donor scenarios.
